title: FOOD-005C - Cart intent + merchandise quote snapshot domain
purpose: Pure exact-SKU cart intent and immutable merchandise quote snapshots that preserve approved commercial price truth without asserting final orderability, fulfillment, tax, checkout or payment readiness.

precedent.cart: FOOD-002A states persistent cart state is convenience only.
precedent.quotation: FOOD-002A requires eventual server quotations to revalidate exact versions plus availability, price, tax treatment, discounts, fees and fulfillment and forbids silent substitution.
precedent.scopeDecision: FOOD-005C therefore creates a merchandise quote foundation only. It must not claim to be the final payable/orderable server quotation while later readiness domains remain unresolved.

contract.cart: FoodCartVersion has a dedicated food-cart identity, positive safe-integer version and ordered exact-SKU lines. Cart state is convenience/intention only and does not establish existence, availability, orderability or price.
contract.cartRevision: Initial cart version is 1. Revisions are consecutive full replacements retaining stable cart identity. No automatic carry, latest/current SKU resolution or hidden merge behavior.
contract.cartLine: Each line retains exact FoodSkuId + SKU version and a positive safe-integer purchase quantity of SKU units. Package net quantity remains a separate FOOD-005A fact.
contract.duplicates: Duplicate exact SKU ID/version lines are rejected. No line identity is introduced in this slice; UI/application merge behavior is not commercial truth.
contract.quote: FoodMerchandiseQuoteVersion is an immutable merchandise-only commercial snapshot with its own identity/version, exact source cart identity/version, exact SKU references, exact approved-price authority ID/version references, immutable unit-price FoodMoney snapshots, quantities, line merchandise subtotals and aggregate merchandise subtotal.
contract.quoteRevision: Initial merchandise quote version is 1. Re-quotation is an explicit consecutive full replacement retaining quote identity and cart identity. Historical quote versions never mutate.
contract.sourceValidation: Quote creation requires explicit canonical SKU snapshots and explicit FOOD-005B approved-commercial-price snapshots for every cart line. There is no latest/current lookup and no automatic price selection.
contract.priceSnapshot: Unit price is copied from the selected exact FOOD-005B price snapshot. Caller-supplied line or aggregate arithmetic is not accepted by quote construction.
contract.money: Reuse FoodMoney and validateFoodMoney. Purchase quantity multiplication and aggregate addition use integer minor units only. Mixed-currency quotes are rejected. Arithmetic above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is rejected. No conversion or rounding is performed.
contract.totals: The only aggregate is merchandiseSubtotal. There is no grand total or amountDue because tax, discounts, delivery/service fees and other charges are not established here.
contract.timestamp: No createdAt, quotedAt, expiresAt or implicit system clock is introduced. Quote expiration policy is deferred.
contract.staleness: A later SKU revision or approved-price revision never rewrites or invalidates historical quote truth. Whether an old quote may currently be accepted is later trusted policy and may require explicit re-quotation.
contract.immutability: All returned snapshots and nested values are detached and frozen. No caller-owned mutable object remains authoritative.
contract.purity: No persistence, clock, random IDs, environment, filesystem, HTTP, network, database, Cloudflare, checkout or payment side effect exists in the domain.

futureHandoffs.FOOD-005D: Consume exact cart/merchandise-quote snapshots while independently adding fulfillment, capacity, availability-window and reservation semantics.
futureHandoffs.FOOD-005E: Retain the exact accepted merchandise quote identity/version, exact SKU versions, exact approved-price versions, quantities and immutable money snapshots in physical order truth.
futureHandoffs.FOOD-005F: Payment remains separate from quote/order truth and must not infer payment readiness from FOOD-005C.

operations: Exactly three local implementation files only. No staging, commit, push, production access, deployment, real food values or external mutation.
